# Button

Two styles, both from the checkout: the 50px primary button, and the quiet apply button that stays grey until it has something to do. Loading keeps the button’s size and cross-fades the label to a spinner.

[Live demo](https://gurfi1.github.io/react-shopify-style-checkout/#/components/button)

## Usage

```tsx
<Button type="submit" fullWidth loading={busy}>Pay now</Button>

<Button variant="quiet" disabled={!code} loading={applying}>Apply</Button>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'quiet'` | Primary is accent on white text. Quiet is grey while disabled, accent once enabled. |
| `loading` | `boolean` | Label fades to a spinner; clicks are ignored; aria-busy is set. |
| `fullWidth` | `boolean` | Stretch to the container. |
| `children` | `ReactNode` | A plain string label animates when it changes. |
| `…button` | `ButtonHTMLAttributes` | type, disabled, onClick and the rest. |

## Files

To use this on its own, copy this folder:

- `Button.module.css`
- `Button.tsx`

It also needs:

- [`src/lib/motion.ts`](../../lib/motion.ts)
- [`src/primitives/Spinner`](../Spinner)
- [`src/utils.ts`](../../utils.ts)

Everything expects a [`Theme`](../../theme) somewhere above it, which supplies the colours, corners and timings.
